# City sections shown as themselves

GeoNames city sections (PPLX) with no town of their municipality within 15 km to fold into (often the city's own record: Ichikawa, Navi Mumbai; or a district of a city whose record lies farther away). A section larger than every town within 15 km ranks with that town's population instead (capped), so a record carrying a whole district's or city's figure does not win rule E far beyond its place; keep 1 in places-overrides.tsv exempts one.
